messages.subject: VetSoft Summit 2026 - Call for Papers
messages.body:
Dear Priya Raghunathan,

We're excited to invite you to submit a proposal for VetSoft Summit 2026, taking place October 14-16 in Portland, Oregon.

As a founder working at the intersection of veterinary practice and technology, your perspective on practice management software would be valuable to our community of veterinary professionals and technology leaders.

We're looking for sessions on:
- Practice management and workflow optimization
- Technology adoption in independent clinics
- Data integration and interoperability
- User experience design for clinical staff

Submission deadline: June 15, 2026
Session format: 30-minute talks or 60-minute workshops
Speaker benefits: Full conference pass, travel stipend available

Submit your proposal here: https://vetsoftsummit.org/cfp-2026

Questions? Reply to this email or contact our program committee at cfp@vetsoftsummit.org.

Best regards,
VetSoft Summit Program Committee

messages.subject: VetSoft Summit 2026 - Call for Papers
messages.body:
Hi Priya,

Just a quick reminder that the Call for Papers deadline for VetSoft Summit 2026 is this Saturday, June 15.

We've received strong interest this year, but we're specifically hoping to include more voices from founders building tools for independent practices. Your work with Thicket on veterinary practice management would bring an important perspective to the conference.

If you're interested but need an extra few days, just let us know—we can work with you.

Submit here: https://vetsoftsummit.org/cfp-2026

Thanks,
VetSoft Summit Program Committee

Priya,

We've extended our CFP deadline to June 25 and wanted to make sure you saw the opportunity.

We're particularly interested in sessions covering:
- Real-world implementation challenges in clinic software
- Building for veterinary technicians and front desk staff
- Lessons learned from early customer pilots

Your experience launching Thicket and working directly with clinics would resonate with our attendees. Even a 30-minute session sharing what you've learned would be incredibly valuable.

New deadline: June 25, 2026
Submit here: https://vetsoftsummit.org/cfp-2026

Hope to see a proposal from you.

Best,
VetSoft Summit Program Committee
